from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from datetime import UTC, datetime
import json, os, subprocess
root=Path("/home/animallya96/deploy/anios")
assert os.getuid()==1000
head=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(root),"rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
assert head=="878cbc53db56f635c8dd9ee6a3307e0d4f1c6b2f"
sources={}
for name in ("backend/cli/market_event_recovery.py","backend/market/event_status.py"):
    sources[name]=sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sources=={"backend/cli/market_event_recovery.py":"9c83058638a018e4635d3d141b1dca2f62cbc036c250cca05721a987f6fd3c40","backend/market/event_status.py":"1adfd4b22be14b07c025e90f90e008a3d795a8de428b9981437ab91bfea28626"}
path=root/"data/market/desk/event-live.json"
with path.open("rb") as handle:
    before=os.fstat(handle.fileno())
    raw=handle.read(65537)
    after=os.fstat(handle.fileno())
assert len(raw)<=65536
fields=("st_dev","st_ino","st_uid","st_gid","st_mode","st_size","st_mtime_ns","st_ctime_ns")
named=path.stat()
assert all(getattr(before,k)==getattr(after,k)==getattr(named,k) for k in fields)
record=json.loads(raw)
selected={k:record[k] for k in ("as_of","status","error_type","state_error_type") if k in record}
last_head=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(root),"rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
assert last_head==head
print(json.dumps({"observed_at":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),"uid":os.getuid(),"head":head,"source_sha256":sources,"path":str(path),"sha256":sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(raw),"physical":{k:str(getattr(before,k)) for k in fields},"selected":selected,"record_keys":sorted(record),"producer_process_observed":False,"producer_exit_code":"UNKNOWN","protected_account_file_opened":False},sort_keys=True))
